$comment: Project-scoped, and committed on purpose: this applies to anyone working on runward, not to whoever
happens to have configured their machine well. The Stop hook runs THIS TREE's gate (dist/, built
first) and refuses to end a turn on a red one. It is one tier stricter than the hook this project
ships to its users, which is advisory by a traced decision (plugins/runward-gate/README.md).
The reason is in .claude/hooks/runward-gate.sh, and the short form is: the author takes the
strictest form of the constraint he sells, not the most comfortable one.

hooks.statusMessage: runward check --strict — the gate, on this tree's own build…
